votes.motion: Approve the work session minutes of December 3, 2024.
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from December 3, 2024.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 1 of 2025, recognizing Cindy Gust-Jenson for her service as Executive Director from February 1989 to January 2025.
votes.description: The Council adopted a ceremonial resolution honoring Cindy Gust-Jenson for her approximately 36 years of service as Executive Director of the Salt Lake City Council Office.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 6 of 2025, amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of the Salt Lake City Library by reallocating $190,000 from employee benefits to capital projects to fund the roof renovation project.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and approved Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for FY2024-25, transferring $190,000 in unused employee benefits funds to pay for the Main Library roof renovation project.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 7 of 2025 for City-wide Text Amendment for Gas Station Standards.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code to establish more stringent zoning standards for gas stations near rivers, streams, water bodies, parks, and open spaces, and prohibiting new gas stations in the secondary groundwater recharge area that do not meet the proposed standards.

votes.motion: Appoint Keith Reynolds as City Recorder.
votes.description: The Council approved the Mayor's appointment of Keith Reynolds to serve as the official City Recorder for Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 8 of 2025, amending the Consolidated Fee Schedule related to the rate stabilization fee in the water and sanitary sewer utilities.
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance clarifying that the Rate Stabilization Fee waiver applies retroactively to July 1, 2024, for customer water and sanitary sewer accounts with continuous non-use of 18 months or longer.

votes.motion: Approve Consent Agenda items G2 (set public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2024-25) and G4 (reappointment of Alfonso Brito to the Business Advisory Board).
votes.description: The Council set February 4, 2025 as the public hearing date for Budget Amendment No. 3 for FY2024-25 and approved the reappointment of Alfonso Brito to the Business Advisory Board for a term ending December 31, 2029.

votes.motion: Approve Consent Agenda item G3, appointing Darin Mano to the Housing Authority of Salt Lake City for a term ending January 21, 2029.
votes.description: The Council approved the appointment of Council Member Darin Mano to the Housing Authority of Salt Lake City board, with Mano recusing himself from the vote.
